one_line: Creator and performer of Ottan Thullal at the Travancore court, satirist-poet of Malayalam theatre.

appearance.age_look: Looks like a energetic man in his late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy, with the wiry build of a dancer and performer.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Kerala complexion, sharp nose, defined cheekbones, slight smile lines around the mouth, lively almond-shaped eyes with thick brows, default expression a keen, amused gaze as if ready with a witty retort.
appearance.hair: Black hair oiled and drawn back into a low, neat knot at the back of the head, with a thin center part; he wears a simple white cotton headband tied around the forehead, the knot tucked at the back so the band forms a clean strip above the brows.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Ottan Thullal performer attire styled modestly: a long-sleeved off-white cotton angavastram-style upper cloth wrapped over both shoulders and chest like a snug shawl, covering the torso fully; below, a white cotton mundu (dhoti) wrapped securely to the ankles with a bold green border and a thinner red line near the hem, pleated in front for ease of movement; around his waist, a broad red cloth belt (udarabandha) wrapped twice and knotted at the side, from which hangs a simple green cloth panel over the front pleats; ankles and wrists adorned with plain brass bangles and thin anklets (no bells, to keep him distinct from Kathakali), a narrow tulsi-wood beaded necklace at the neck, and simple leather sandals on his feet; overall textiles are handwoven cotton with a slightly coarse texture and minimal patterning, just coloured borders.
appearance.signature: A long palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a cotton cord, held in his left hand or tucked under his arm, with a short wooden palm-leaf stylus tucked into his waist-belt, symbolising his Thullal compositions and improvisations.

ref_desc: Kunchan Nambiar is a lean medium-brown Kerala man with an oval face, lively eyes, oiled black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white long-sleeved upper wrap, white mundu with green and red borders, red waist-belt, simple brass ornaments, and carrying a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus, in off-white, leaf green, deep red, warm brown and brass gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Kunchan Nambiar: a lean, energetic Kerala man in his late 30s–40s with an oval medium-brown face, sharp nose, defined cheekbones, and lively almond-shaped eyes under thick brows, his default expression a keen, amused gaze as if ready to perform. His black hair is oiled, parted in the center, drawn into a low knot at the back, and wrapped with a simple white cotton headband forming a clean strip across his forehead. He wears a modest, era-accurate Travancore Ottan Thullal performer outfit: a long-sleeved off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped snugly over both shoulders and chest like a shawl, fully covering the torso, and a white cotton mundu falling to the ankles with a bold leaf-green border and a thin deep-red line near the hem, pleated in front for movement. Around his waist, show a broad deep-red cloth belt wrapped twice and knotted at the side, with a small green cloth panel hanging over the front pleats. Add simple accessories: plain brass bangles at his wrists, thin brass anklets, a narrow tulsi-wood bead necklace, and plain leather sandals. His signature prop is a long palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with cotton cord, held in his left hand or tucked under his arm, with a short wooden stylus tucked into his waist-belt. Use a palette of off-white, leaf green, deep red, warm brown skin tones, and brass gold accents, and present him from multiple angles to emphasise consistent face, hair, clothing details, and the manuscript bundle as his constant attribute.
